subject.title: RFC: Readiness Framework and Hosting Profiles

question: Should existing installations with no explicit hosting profile preserve today's readiness semantics, or inherit the RFC's new required `local` criteria on upgrade?
rationale: This choice determines whether a routine upgrade may remove instances from service and establishes permanent configuration, readiness, and plugin-provider compatibility semantics.

options.title: Preserve unset upgrades
options.body: Keep current readiness semantics unless an operator explicitly selects or migrates to stricter hosting conformance.

options.title: Strengthen local by default
options.body: Apply the new required local criteria to all installations with explicit migration guidance, release communication, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Accept providers first
options.body: Adopt canonical readiness-provider aggregation while deferring implicit profile defaults and operator promotion until compatibility is settled.

recommendation.title: Preserve unset upgrades
recommendation.body: Keep current readiness semantics unless an operator explicitly selects or migrates to stricter hosting conformance.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main Gateway readiness work makes this the strongest available owner for the user-visible availability and upgrade-contract choice.
